notes: Three routes meet at «عبيد الله»: the first (Muqaddami and Zuhayr through Yahya) is joined by the taḥwīl to the second (Abu Bakr through Abu Usama) and third (Ibn Numayr through his father); the dual «قالا حدثنا عبيد الله» makes «نافع» and «ابن عمر» a shared tail.
«- وهو ابن سعيد -» and «- واللفظ لهما -» are editor's glosses between dashes; left out.
«أن عمر، قال يا رسول الله» is Umar asking within the story Ibn Umar tells; Umar is in the scene and Ibn Umar is the last link (rule 5).
